  "Blue‑whitish veil is a major criterion worth 2 points.",
  "Visual verification should include checking for a confluent blue pigment with an overlying white haze, irregular radial lines or pseudopods, asymmetric blotches of pigment, varied size and uneven distribution of dots or globules, and blue peppering or scar‑like areas."
